caption_L1: This line plot is titled Puma 's operating income (EBIT) worldwide from 1993 to 2019 (in million euros). On the x-axis, Year is defined on a linear scale with a minimum of 1995 and a maximum of 2015. There is a linear scale from 0 to 400 along the y-axis, labeled Operating income in million euros.
caption_L2L3: There are a lot of fluctuations on this graph. From 1993 to 2017 the operating income has grown from 0 to over 400 million euros. However there is a steep rise in 2000 -2005 from approx 20 million to 380 million euros and a steeper drop 2011-2012 from 340 to 100 million euros. The income then recovers in 2013 to 200 million drops again in 2015 before becoming 400 million in 2019.
